judge.rationale: The agent identifies the wrong March all-hands (m-108/Copperleaf) rather than m-004/Meridian and reports an entirely different set of projects and statuses. It omits Ledgerline, Wayfare, Larkspur Archive, Kestrel CRM, and Beacon Grid, replacing them with Curlew, Perchboard, Foxglove, and Cinderboard.
